selection.rule: 32 S&P 500 snapshot securities across 9 nonfinancial GICS sectors; retain AAPL and MSFT baseline; exclude Financials and Real Estate pending separate accounting/security mappings.

membership_source.limitation: Frozen current-constituent snapshot only; source file identifies its upstream as datasets_sp500_wikipedia_mirror for these selected rows. It contains no historical membership intervals.

issuer_mapping_source.limitation: Current ticker-to-CIK association only. The cohort CSV freezes these mappings; it does not reconstruct historical ticker/security identity changes.

survivorship_bias.treatment: Pilot only. Do not use this current-member cohort for historical correlation, forecast training, or investable-performance claims.
survivorship_bias.research_gate: Before historical return research, acquire a point-in-time universe with effective membership intervals, persistent security identifiers, ticker changes, delisted securities, and delisting/corporate-action returns.
